channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Wartales - Contract: The Tavern Opens!
item.description: Manage and expand your own tavern in this management and simulation expansion for Wartales. During your adventures, secure wealth and prestige for your troop.

item.title: Empires of the Undergrowth - Supporter Pack
item.description: The Empires of the Undergrowth Supporter Pack features the official Empires of the Undergrowth soundtrack, 4k wallpapers, a new ant skin for your colonies, and more.

item.title: Summer Days in the Joyful Countryside
item.description: Welcome your nieces to your rural home to help them enjoy a summer vacation of relaxation, farming, and gaming!

item.title: Battle Brothers - Beasts & Exploration
item.description: The 'Beasts & Exploration' DLC for Battle Brothers expands the game with a larger world, hidden legendary locations, a crafting system, armor attachments, new equipment, as well as a variety of new opponents, contracts and events!

item.title: Battle Brothers - Warriors of the North
item.description: The 'Warriors of the North' DLC for Battle Brothers expands the game with a more distinct northern region, as well as different starting scenarios to pick for your mercenary company. Face an entirely new faction of barbarians in battle, and wear new viking and rus themed gear!

item.title: Data Center
item.description: Build, cable, and automate. Assemble racks, servers, and switches, connect enough capacity for each app, earn money from processed data, and unlock gear and bigger customers with XP and reputation. Follow colored data packets as your center comes to life.

item.title: Machinefall
item.description: Machinefall is a post-apocalyptic real time strategy game set on a fully playable global map. Lead humanity’s last survivors as they build bases, gather resources, and wage massive battles against an overwhelming machine swarm. Progress through technological eras from Stone Age to Atomic Age.

item.title: Urbek City Builder - Trains
item.description: Build an intricate web of trains and stations to connect your population for heightened productivity in work and science. Link key buildings like iron mines to steelworks for maximum industrial efficiency.

item.title: Battle Brothers - Blazing Deserts
item.description: The 'Blazing Deserts' DLC for Battle Brothers expands the game with a new land to the south. Visit independent city states, fight in the arena, face desert raiders and southern beasts in battle. Wear new gear inspired by Arabian and Persian cultures and test your mettle in a new late game crisis!

item.title: Dig for TCG Cards With Your Friends
item.description: A cozy junkyard card-collecting sim - now with online co-op. Dig through mountains of trash with friends, hunt rare collectible cards, sell your junk for profit, and upgrade your gear.

item.title: Galaxy Burger
item.description: 🌴👩‍🍳🍔 A stress-free cooking game that lets you relax! Cook up burgers for mecha cats and aliens. Play solo or with up to 7 friends!

item.title: GERONIMO
item.description: GERONIMO is an immersive, tactical CQB shooter built for Virtual Reality that depicts a modern-day world in which Tier 1 operators are called to implement unconventional operations as members of elite teams. Breaching, in-depth character and weapon customization and more! "Who Dares, Wins"

item.title: INSANIO
item.description: Autobattler where you send misfits into vehicular combat. Your job is to prepare them, deploy them, watch them struggle and finally watch them die or win in massive explosions.

item.title: The Hong Kong Massacre
item.description: Blast your way through the streets of Hong Kong in a fast-paced, top-down shooter. Inspired by classic action movies, The Hong Kong Massacre places you at the center of a hard-boiled revenge story, filled with brutal, cinematic shootouts and vivid underworld locations.

item.title: UnLoop
item.description: ⚠️VR-only. Your mic is recording. Your actions too.⚠️ Infiltrate a retro space station. Get trapped in a time loop. Your past copies will replay every word you said and every mistake you made. You're the team. You're also the problem.

item.title: Urbek City Builder
item.description: Urbek is a city building game where you can build your own neighbourhoods: from nightlife district to industrial district. Don't exhaust your natural resources before you have an educated population to build more efficient structures.
